# GitHub Repository SEO & Crawler Optimization Guide

To ensure that Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, and GitHub's search engines rank this repository at the very top when software engineers search for FAANG interview preparation materials, follow these recommendations:

---

## 1. Repository Topics (Tags on GitHub)
Go to your repository homepage on GitHub (`https://github.com/SUSHIL1312/crack-the-code`), click the gear icon ⚙️ beside **About**, and add these exact 20 tags into the **Topics** field:

```
faang-interview-prep
software-engineering
coding-interview
operating-systems
computer-networks
system-design
rest-api-design
modern-cpp
cpp20
cpp23
concurrency-programming
multithreading
leetcode-solutions
interview-preparation
linux-kernel
distributed-systems
zero-to-hero
google-interview
meta-interview
amazon-interview
```

---

## 2. Repository Description (Bio)
Set the repository **Description** in the GitHub UI to:
> *Zero to Hero FAANG & Tier-1 Product Company Interview Preparation Curriculum. Covers Operating Systems, Computer Networks, Modern C++20/C++23, System Design, REST API Architecture, and Concurrency with hands-on labs and test suites.*

**Website link**: Set to `https://github.com/SUSHIL1312/crack-the-code` or GitHub Pages if enabled.

---

## 3. How Search Engines Index this Repository
1. **Robots.txt & Sitemap.xml**: A canonical `robots.txt` and `sitemap.xml` are located at the root of the repository, enabling web crawlers to map all core CS, modern C++, and system design modules.
2. **JSON-LD Schema Markup**: The root `README.md` embeds Schema.org `Course` and `EducationalApplication` metadata, which Googlebot parses to generate Google Search Rich Snippets.
3. **Keyword Density**: Core search queries ("FAANG interview preparation", "Operating Systems interview questions", "REST API Design checklist", "Modern C++ concurrency") are represented in headings, code annotations, and comparison tables.
